title: Paul in Berea
description: In Berea, the Jews received the message with great eagerness and examined the Scriptures daily to see if Paul's message was true. Many came to believe, including prominent Greek women and men. But when the Jews from Thessalonika heard that God's word was being preached in Berea, they came there and stirred up the crowds. The brothers sent Paul on to Athens, while Silas and Timothy remained behind.
